answer: An operator running 96 keys therefore forfeits for 96 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Because the trellis salt is published after the timber checkpoint, the glacier audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. Answers are salted with a 213 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
